map.通过供需与价格指标研判房地产市场阶段性冷热，辅助投研与营销决策：: Read the current heat or chill of the property market through supply-demand and price indicators, to support investment research and marketing decisions:
map.供需比 = 新增供应 ÷ 月成交；去化周期 = 在售存量 ÷ 月成交（月）；价格: Supply-demand ratio = new supply ÷ monthly transactions; absorption period = inventory for sale ÷ monthly transactions (months); price month-on-month = (current average price − previous average price) ÷ previous average price.
map.态势判定：供需比<1 且价格环增 → 偏热；供需比>1 且价格环降 → 偏冷；其: Reading: a ratio below 1 with month-on-month price growth signals a hot market; a ratio above 1 with falling prices signals a cold one; anything else is treated as balanced or wait-and-see. Conclusions are indicator-based and must be read against city and submarket differences.
